name: Toho Zinc Co.,Ltd.
summary: Toho Zinc Co., Ltd., a diversified Japanese company established in Tokyo in 1937, operates in building materials, environmental solutions and recycling, mineral resource management, electronic components and materials, and metal smelting and refining. Its smelting yields electrolytic zinc, zinc powder and zinc alloys for die casting, and it recycles dust from furnaces and small rechargeable batteries. It also sells SOFT CALM sound insulation materials.
